_note: Which write conditions each VFS honours, per operation, for write: conditional. put = PutObject If-Match; copy = CopyObject If-Match / x-amz-copy-source-if-match; delete = DeleteObject If-Match and the DeleteObjects per-key ETag. A VFS with no op cannot mount conditional. Both hosts' WRITE_CONDITIONS must equal this table, and it must name every registered VFS.

_evidence.s3: measured: AWS S3 us-west-2, 2026-10-04 (put, create, copy If-Match, multipart, delete If-Match) and 2026-10-06 (copy If-None-Match, CopySourceIfMatch, DeleteObjects ETag)
_evidence.seaweedfs: measured: SeaweedFS 4.48 local, 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-06, all cases honoured
_evidence.minio: measured: MinIO (CI image cgr.dev/chainguard/minio@sha256:bd0143…, release dated 2026-09-22): put and create honoured; copy If-Match and If-None-Match, DeleteObject If-Match and DeleteObjects ETag ignored
_evidence.s3+endpoint: type: s3 with a non-AWS endpoint_url may be any S3-compatible server, MinIO included, so it gets MinIO's row
_evidence.assumed: aliyun, backblaze, ceph, digitalocean, gcs, oci, qingstor, r2, scaleway, supabase, tencent, wasabi: ASSUMED via the shared S3 protocol by user decision (2026-10-05); not measured per provider
_evidence.box: measured: Box API, 2026-10-05 (new-version upload If-Match: stale etag 412, current 201) and 2026-10-08 (DELETE /files/{id} If-Match: stale 412 precondition_failed, current 204, gone 404). The cache holds the file's sha1; a write compares it with the live sha1 and sends the live etag. A copy, move or upload onto a taken name answers 409 item_name_in_use with context_info.conflicts naming the item there, file or folder (2026-10-08).
